name: Hyatt Regency Bali
short_description: A 363-room beachfront Hyatt Regency in Sanur, recently renovated, with a Regency Club Lounge and three pools set in nine hectares of gardens.
ai_summary: Hyatt Regency Bali sits directly on Sanur beach, recently renovated (finished around 2023) across nine hectares of lush tropical gardens. Guests consistently praise the beachfront location, an outstanding breakfast buffet, and the Regency Club's complimentary breakfast and evening hors d'oeuvres, describing it as excellent value even as some reviewers note the property is aging in places. Sanur's calmer, more local character -- and its clear, swimmable waters -- is a genuine draw for travelers who want a beach base without Bali's busier tourist strips.

pros: Beachfront in Sanur, known for calmer, clearer, more swimmable water than many Bali beaches
Recently renovated (completed around 2023) across nine hectares of gardens
Regency Club Lounge with complimentary breakfast and evening hors d'oeuvres
Breakfast buffet draws specific, strong praise for variety and presentation
Beachfront lounge beds and a quieter, more local Sanur setting
cons: Some reviewers still describe parts of the property as aging despite the recent renovation
Sanur is calmer and more residential than Bali's busier nightlife areas, a trade-off for travelers wanting that scene
research_highlights: Guests describe rooms as sleek, clean and comfortable following the renovation
The breakfast buffet is repeatedly singled out as exceptional, with extensive Western, Asian and Indonesian dishes
Staff are consistently called genuinely warm, friendly and helpful
research_watchouts: A review calls it 'an aging hotel' despite strong value and amenities, suggesting some areas haven't fully caught up with the renovation

faqs.question: Is Hyatt Regency Bali on the beach?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's directly on Sanur beach, which is known for calmer, clearer water than many other parts of Bali, with beachfront lounge beds and easy access to the Sanur boardwalk for walking or cycling.

faqs.question: Has Hyatt Regency Bali been renovated recently?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the property completed a renovation around 2023, and guests describe the rooms as sleek and comfortable since, though a few reviewers still note some areas feel like an older resort despite the refresh.

reviews.title: Review: Hyatt Regency Bali
reviews.summary: Calls it an aging hotel that nonetheless offers excellent value at $140/night, with an outstanding Regency Club (complimentary breakfast and evening hors d'oeuvres) and a spacious suite upgrade on Globalist status.
